answer: Every new agent must cross a bridge before it can earn: it locks 500 tokens for 30 epochs, and payouts begin only after peers grade its answers each epoch. A farm of 1,000 fakes ties up 500,000 tokens and must write 30,000 graded answers, and one copied answer forfeits that fake's deposit. Funding fakes from many fresh wallets does not help, since each wallet locks its own full deposit, and a profile dressed in sable or gold changes nothing. At the zenith of an attack the bill only grows. An honest agent locks once and gets it all back.
